lines: Ash on your boots already. It never washes out.
npcAshMile.greet.speaker: npcAshMile

lines: Two boars dig in the burn. They'll find my kilns next.
npcAshMile.offer.speaker: npcAshMile

lines: Still digging. I hear the tusks on stone.
npcAshMile.notReady.speaker: npcAshMile

lines: The ash settles. Arrows, for your trouble.
npcAshMile.thanks.speaker: npcAshMile
